victoryMessage: The Empire of England now dominates all of western Europe. Your armies stand invincible and your remaining rivals kneel at your feet!
dscr: The kingdom of England is thriving under its new Norman rulers and is ready to conquer new lands. Isolated on an island, England enjoys a relatively secure position, with only the French posing an immediate threat.

victoryMessage: The Empire of France now dominates all of western Europe. Your armies stand invincible and your remaining rivals kneel at your feet!
dscr: As heirs of Charlemagne and centre of European culture, the French see it as their duty to rebuild the old Frankish empire. It will, however, take both tact and might to handle the ambitions of the neighboring Germans, English and Spanish.

victoryMessage: The German Empire now dominates all of western Europe. Your armies stand invincible and your remaining rivals kneel at your feet!
dscr: The Germans see their 'Holy Roman Empire' as a righteous continuation of the ancient Roman Empire. Their potential enemies are many, but their duty is clear: to carry imperial rule ro every corner of the continent.

victoryMessage: The Empire of the Moors now dominates all of western Europe. Your armies stand invincible and your remaining rivals kneel at your feet!
dscr: The Moorish people of northern Africa have thrived under Islam, having conquered most of Spain before being pushed back into its southern half. Despite incursions from Christian kingdoms, they remain a centre of culture and military might.

victoryMessage: The Spanish Empire now dominates all of western Europe. Your armies stand invincible and your remaining rivals kneel at your feet!
dscr: The Spanish have only recently achieved the unity necessary to make significant gains against the Moors. Still, no true Spaniard can rest until all of the Iberian peninsula belongs to the crown. After that the rest of Europe will follow.
